PathOfBuilding.Notes:
Level off the beach with Cobra Lash until Level 4 / Hillock
New stuff highlighted in ^xFFFF77Yellow^7.
Level 4: ^xFFFF77Rolling Magma + Elemental Proliferation^7 ^xFFFF77Flame Wall^7 ^xFFFF77Frostblink + Arcane Surge^7 (DON'T LEVEL ARCANE SURGE PAST 1)
NOTE: ^x8888FFArcane Surge^7 was buffed in 3.26 to provide a flat 20% cast speed and 30% mana regen at all levels, and when linked with Frostblink (or any skill) will proc constantly. Cast Speed is a multiplier for your damage but more importantly, makes Rolling Magma feel less bad on a non-caster. ^xE05030This will dramatically improve your quality of life^7. If you have the socket just keep it linked with Frostblink as it will reduce your mana costs as you campaign by boosting the effectiveness of Clarity.
Level 8: Rolling Magma + Elemental Proliferation + ^xFFFF77Combustion^7 Flame Wall ^xFFFF77Bear Trap^7 Frostblink + Arcane Surge (Still level 1 Arcane Surge) ^xFFFF77Shield Charge + Momentum + Faster Attacks^7 ^xFFFF77Clarity^7
Level 16: Rolling Magma + Elemental Proliferation + Combustion Flame Wall ^xFFFF77Wave of Conviction^7 ^xFFFF77Summon Skitterbots^7 Frostblink + Arcane Surge (Still level 1 Arcane Surge) Shield Charge + Momentum + Faster Attacks Clarity
Level 31: ^xE05030Run Library for Charged Mines^7, ^xE05030gamble for a 4L^7 ^xFFFF77Pyroclast Mines + Swift Assembly + Added Cold Damage + Charged Mines^7 ^xFFFF77Automation + Detonate Mines^7 Bear Trap Wave of Conviction Summon Skitterbots Frostblink + Arcane Surge (Still level 1 Arcane Surge) Shield Charge + Momentum + Faster Attacks Clarity ^xFFFF77Flammability^7 ^xFFFF77Grace^7
^xFFFF77Bench flat fire damage to spells on a weapon^7
Level 38: Pyroclast Mines + ^xFFFF77Minefield^7 + Added Cold Damage + Charged Mines^7 Automation + Detonate Mines Bear Trap Wave of Conviction Summon Skitterbots Frostblink + Arcane Surge (Still level 1 Arcane Surge) Shield Charge + Momentum + Faster Attacks Clarity Flammability^7 Grace^7
Level 55: Pyroclast Mines + Minefield + ^xFFFF77Elemental Focus ^7+ Charged Mines^7 Automation + Detonate Mines Flame Wall Bear Trap Wave of Conviction Summon Skitterbots Frostblink + Arcane Surge (Still level 1 Arcane Surge) Shield Charge + Momentum + Faster Attacks Clarity Flammability^7 Grace^7 ^xFFFF77Guard Skill, probably Automation + Steelskin^7
Add Enduring Cry in early maps while waiting to source another Endurance Charge generator (Enduring Composure cluster -OR- Eldritch implicit)
